name: Cute Ancient Egyptian Catgirls Bastet and Sekhmet Appeared??!
source:
If a pair of cute catgirls appeared at your doorstep... What would you do???

Now... What if they were cute catgirl gods??!!

You don't have anything you wouldn't want them to see, right??!

A short comedy visual novel poking fun at the catgirl genre.

[From [url=https://saturn-murray.itch.io/cute-ancient-egyptian-catgirls-bastet-and-sekhmet-appeared]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果一对可爱的猫娘出现在你家门口……你会怎么做？？？

现在…如果他们是可爱的猫女神怎么办？！！

你没有什么不想让他们看到的，对吧？？！

一部取笑猫女类型的短喜剧视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://saturn-murray.itch.io/cute-ancient-egyptian-catgirls-bastet-and-sekhmet-appeared]Itch.io[/url]]
